analysis: The two units are head-side text of docs/architecture/inference.md. The file_changes patch shows only a 'Last updated' date bump and one new troubleshooting table row near line 3552 (a macOS 27.2 pre-release crash with SDK 27.2 Date comparisons). The supplied units (lines 5244-5707) are unchanged surrounding documentation: GLM tensor-parallel placement and serving, MTP decode policy, media over TP, pipeline decode command buffers, cluster stage KV precision, SSD prefix record encoding, and GPT-OSS paged KV. No code, config, key handling, authorization, or attestation behavior changes in this PR. I checked the described prefix-cache behavior against T-041. The text keeps tenant partitioning (prefixScope/prefixDiskScope), encrypted SSD records, sealed (AES-GCM) peer exchanges, and a fail-closed agreement on mismatched encodings. It does not loosen the 30-minute TTL, the HMAC naming, or the account scoping. Lossy encoded SSD records are documented as accepted, with index keys kept native. This is a documentation statement, not a regression. The new troubleshooting row at ~3552 is outside the supplied units; its visible patch excerpt is truncated, so I cannot assess its full text, but it is a diagnostic note with no security control implied. No threat-model assumption is invalidated. Remaining uncertainty: the claims in the doc (for example the DARKBLOOM_GLM_TP_* switches being forwarded to both Macs' environments) describe code outside this PR and were not verified.
